profile.headline: Technical Lead & Senior Software Engineer at Slack | Infrastructure & Orchestration
profile.summary:

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Technical lead of the Core Infra Orchestration team at Slack. We’re working on a new platform that is now running and deploying 80% of Slack’s stack! 

- Leading a team of 10 engineers, building products that enhance scalability and reliability, lower cost, empower resilience, and reduce toil while not compromising on deploy speed or efficiency
- Architecting a brand new kubernetes EKS backed platform, to help our engineers deliver the products and features that make Slack wonderful to use.
- Building a suite of AI-powered agents that automate orchestration, security updates, deploys, rollbacks, cost reduction, incident response, and reliability at Slack.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development on the Compute++ and Storage team for VMware Cloud Director (VCD), working on vSphere storage and compute infrastructure integration.

• Served as tech lead for VCD VM Encryption integration, IOPS integration, and storage policy entity type partitioning — leading planning, development, documentation, testing, and release

• Mentored co-ops, interns, and new engineers, guiding their design work and sprint planning

• Member of the VCD API Guild, reviewing all API changes across the Cloud Director engineering organization (30+ engineers) and providing guidance on API design best practices, performance, and sustainability

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Promoted to SWE III on the Cloud Director team; took on increasing ownership of feature development and cross-team technical collaboration.
• Led end-to-end delivery of storage and compute features for vCloud Director, from design through production release
• Expanded mentorship responsibilities, onboarding new team members and guiding junior engineers through their first feature deliveries
• Deepened involvement in API Guild activities, contributing to organization-wide standards for API design and backward compatibility

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Software developer and feature lead on the CPoM and Storage team of vCloud Director, working on cloud infrastructure management and storage orchestration.
• Led feature development for storage-related components of VCD, coordinating with partner teams on integration and testing
• Contributed to system reliability through schema maintenance, ensuring database consistency and model integrity across releases

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
First full-time role after graduating from Northeastern. Joined the VDC Services Team of vCloud Director.
• Developed and maintained backend services for VMware’s cloud infrastructure platform
• Contributed to the team’s Java/Spring codebase, participating in code reviews, testing, and production deployments

positions.title: Backend Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, and shipped a database migration tool enabling VCD customers to migrate from SQL Server/Oracle to PostgreSQL — released as part of Trifecta
• Implemented BFS/DFS graph traversal to construct foreign key dependency graphs at runtime for safe migration ordering
• Built and maintained integration test infrastructure using Jenkins and vCloud Director testbeds

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Development Co-op
positions.description: Built microservices and interactive web applications for ThirdChannel’s retail intelligence platform using Spring Boot, Java, and JavaScript. Implemented service integrations and KPI data visualization dashboards.

positions.title: Illustrator/Designer
positions.description:
Created illustrations for Chesterton the Weasel books
Built and compiled illustrations and book text using Adobe InDesign

positions.title: Art Teacher
positions.description:
Guided elementary-school students through basic drawing and painting techniques
Encouraged good art practices and provided constructive criticism for struggling students

honors.title: Grace Hopper Sponsorship
honors.description: Awarded full sponsorship to attend the Grace Hopper conference for women in computing in 2016 representing Northeastern University.
